**Which page?**
Name the wiki page (or say it is missing). Example: `Events`, `Building-Situations`, a new page title.

**What is wrong or missing?**
A specific gap, error, or section you want added — not a general "we should document more."

**Suggested change**
What the page should say, or a sketch of the new section. Link a Discussion if this started there.

**Related code**
`game/scripts/…` paths if you know them.
